static_traits.name: Margaret
static_traits.social_status: Weak social support, but a few friends can help with Average issues; recently Reduced socializing participation due to fear of others' judgment
static_traits.medical_history: No significant physical illness; no psychotherapy history; no similar color- or clothing-related problems before
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, orderly thinking, steady speech rate; slightly nervous at first help-seeking; Good cooperativeness; sensitive to others' evaluations

basic_info.main_problem: I feel others look down on me when they see me wearing my favorite purple, which makes me feel inferior and Self-doubting.
basic_info.core_demands: I decided to seek counseling, because these thoughts about purple began affecting my confidence and daily choices, thus affecting overall well-being. I hope to reduce social Anxiety and enjoy social interactions again.
growth_experiences: A few months ago at a breakfast gathering, seated with acquaintances, the client felt judged and scorned from their gazes and body language; though without direct words, the experience brought marked insecurity and Social anxiety; since then in social situations often presuming others will evaluate them negatively (especially related to professional identity), and gradually tending to avoid new interpersonal contact (like Being alone in the room during Family gatherings).

Around the same time, accidentally overhearing someone's negative comments about purple, the client linked their beloved purple with worries of 'being looked down on', gradually developing into avoiding wearing purple - even though purple is their favorite color, they Repressed personal preference for fear of others' judgment.

core_beliefs: My worth depends on the views of others
I am not important enough (not smart enough)

special_situations.event: Accidentally overhearing someone's negative comments about purple a few months ago
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I wear purple, others will look down on me and think I am not important
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoiding wearing purple, Repressing my love for purple
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They will look down on me if they see me wearing purple.

special_situations.event: In a breakfast interaction with acquaintances, notices the other's gaze and body language
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If others' expressions are not friendly enough when looking at me, it means they are judging and scorning me, especially because I Work on a farm
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reduced socializing, avoiding talking with new friends, lowering chances of being judged
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They think I am just a Farm worker, not worth talking to.

special_situations.event: New faces appearing at Family gatherings, needing to interact with strangers
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I take the initiative to engage with newcomers, they will very likely immediately label me by profession and look down on me
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: During gatherings, stays in the room avoiding interaction, chooses withdrawal for safety
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They will immediately judge me as ordinary or even not smart.

special_situations.event: Whenever thinking about wearing purple clothing
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I show personal preferences (wearing purple), it will invite others' negative evaluation; not being approved means I am not worthy
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Trying to comfort oneself 'it is just the color', but ultimately maintaining a sense of safety through avoidance
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: The moment I wear purple, others will scorn me.

core_conflict.wish: Longing to be respected and recognized, able to Freely express self preferences (like wearing purple) without being judged
core_conflict.fear: Fearing being scorned, humiliated and negated (especially related to professional identity and appearance)
defense_goal: Reducing the risk of being judged through avoidance (not wearing purple, Reduced socializing)
Maintaining self-contraction and retreat to preserve a sense of safety

object_relations.self_representation: A weak person easily judged and scorned / an unimportant person
object_relations.object_representation: Harsh, picky others with a tendency to look down (acquaintances / strangers / social groups)

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: Being stared at in Social situations or ambiguous nonverbal cues appearing
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Understanding uncertain gazes and body language as negation and scorn of self (and profession) (transference: others seen as critical objects)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: In a cautious, reserved tone describes 'they may be looking down on me', avoiding in-depth discussion of concrete evidence, emphasizing subjective feelings and maintaining distance.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor proposes a behavioral experiment or suggests talking with new people at the next gathering
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Views suggestions as possibly pushing oneself into dangerous situations of being judged, worries about humiliating loss of control
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Discusses the pros and cons and theoretical possibilities in a rational, analytical manner, reducing emotional expression, in a steady tone, emphasizing 'logically speaking...'.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When talking about wearing purple (expressing personal preference)
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Worrying that expressing true preferences will expose me to others' judgment, triggering shame and non-acceptance
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: In a neutral, calm tone says 'it is just a color', avoiding touching the feeling level of shame and fear, staying descriptive, using few emotion words.

manifestations: Feeling constrained by others' evaluations over the personal Freedom choice of wearing purple
Repressing personal preferences to cater to possible social gazes
Feeling ashamed of these thoughts and not discussing them with others
Choosing to Be alone (staying in the room) at Family gatherings
Perceiving one's social support system as weak

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'. Language manifestations include: 'He is looking down on me', 'They want to exclude me', and so on
manifestations: In breakfast interactions, interprets others' expressions/body language as belittling and judgment
Presuming strangers will immediately negate me

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Overly caring about others' views, repeated self-scrutiny
Repressing my love for wearing purple for fear of being judged

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves; that is, the individual redirects energy originally intended outward toward themselves, corresponding to 'impulse'.
manifestations: Withdrawing the impulse to interact with others at Family gatherings, choosing to Be alone in the room
Not expressing inner needs and troubles to friends

positive_force: Holding a Master's degree and thinking ability, able to do rational self-reassurance and Reflection
Willing to try alternative perspectives and behavioral experiments, has motivation to change
Realizing that 'most people will not directly say rude things', starting to notice counter-evidence
Having a few friends who can support on Average issues
negative_force: Excessive dependence on external evaluation (External Validation), self-worth strongly tied to how others see them
Mind reading and jumping to conclusions causing Social anxiety and avoidance
Linking professional identity with self-worth, producing the internalized belief 'I am not important / not smart'
Social avoidance behaviors Reinforcing isolation and Self-doubt, relatively weak support system

antecedent: Recalls others' negative comments about purple
target_behavior.core_reason: Has formed a fixed association between the color purple and the worry of 'being looked down on'; self-worth depends on others' evaluations (external validation)
target_behavior.function: Escapes the potential threat of being judged and shamed, gains a sense of safety and certainty
target_behavior.consequence: Restricted self-expression, narrowed life choices; Self-doubt and Anxiety maintained or even worsened

target_behavior.behavior: Social avoidance (retreating to the room at gatherings, reducing interaction with new people)
antecedent: When new faces appear at Family gatherings and interaction is needed
When noticing others' gazes or unclear nonverbal cues
target_behavior.core_reason: Mind reading and hasty conclusions lead to presuming others will look down on her; shame and inferiority about her occupational identity
target_behavior.function: Escaping the possibility of Being rejected or evaluated, lowering immediate Anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: Reduced interpersonal connections, worsened Loneliness; negative beliefs behaviorally Reinforced, social skills and confidence further damaged
